steps.content: You're caught in the thick of the crowd, as crammed as sardines, all shuffling towards that tin-can of a building.
As you move, you're piecing together the puzzle of your current situation, step by step.
Eleven's lost power now clings to a vintage terminal... Blending her residual might with my shackles, the story of Call at 3 AM is spread anew...
Could it be, these whispers and the feelings they evoke have birthed another realm like this?
But why tread the same path again? To whom does that vintage terminal belong? Is all this just to keep the memory of "Call at 3 AM" alive in everyone's mind?
You look up at the skyscraper looming so close by...
Back at the TV station... What's lurking in its shadows?

As you step into the building, the thought of sneaking past the snarling turnstile without ID crosses your mind. But to your surprise, when the tide of people sweeps you to the front, the facial recognition system mirrors someone else's face, not yours.

steps.speaker: A Robotic Tone
steps.content: Access granted. Welcome aboard, Eleven.
It hits you then. When you engage your shackles, you find Eleven's position coinciding with yours... Somehow, you and Eleven have become one and the same.

options: Could this be another spooky tale...

choices.text: Could this be another spooky tale...

steps.content: All I can offer is... my sincerest apologies... It wasn't fair to you... I'm truly sorry...
steps.female_content: Honestly, this is the first time I've ever faced anything like this...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No... It feels like a fragment of my mind is now intertwined with yours...
steps.female_content: Same here... I've only known how to disconnect, never to become one with another like this...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's kind of enchanting...
steps.female_content: But, I actually feel it's more like a part of my consciousness has connected with yours...

steps.content: Like making a phone call, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's hard to say for sure...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Considering it's my power, who's to say it isn't the birth of a brand-new urban legend?
But I think it's just a partial merging of minds, kind of like we're on a phone call.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You see... I genuinely couldn't feel you were there. I assumed I was alone in the crowd heading to the building, until just a moment ago when it hit me...
It looks like we only hear each other when we're both aware.
So, where are you hiding?
The shackles suggest you're close by, maybe right in my spot.
While talking, you head to the well-known second floor. Around the corner, you spot an elegantly dressed full-length mirror.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Huh? Do I... see you?
I feel the same...
As you move towards the mirror, it reflects two images—you and Eleven.
Eleven is right in front of you, casting a silhouette that enshrouds you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Does it feel like... you've turned into a guardian angel on my back?
Through the mirror, you watch Eleven raise her hand, and you do the same. Yet, as you attempt to move beyond her, to stand in front of her, you realize you're unable to.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's still a realm born from my abilities, my fixation... So, I guess I'm the one in control, right...
Probably a good thing, actually. You know this TV station better than me, so it makes sense for you to lead.
While you both are taking it all in, a ruckus suddenly breaks out on the third floor.

steps.speaker: Employee A
steps.content: Work! Work! Work builds value, brings happiness, and realizes dreams!!

steps.speaker: Employee B
steps.content: Work... Argh... Argh... Argh... Survive, then slave away...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: That's my old workplace up there!
Let's head up and check it out!
Eleven guides you to the third floor, and what you see is startling—

The office is teeming with people. Even though it's way past midnight, nearly everyone's glued to their desks. Amid the brightly illuminated cubicles, a symphony of footsteps and chatter fills the air.
The workers, with their bizarre head, labor mechanically but with fervor, making you almost believe in the "upbeat and dynamic corporate culture" illusion.

options: Is this the norm at the TV station...?
Is this the onset of a Corruptor outbreak?

choices.text: Is this the norm at the TV station...?
Is this the onset of a Corruptor outbreak?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: First time at the TV station, huh? Because of varying show times, there are always people working, even in the dead of night.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This is especially true for the current events team. At critical times, they're practically on call around the clock.
Ruthless company... MBCC at least shells out for extra hours.
...Or offers compensatory leave.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: These fabricated realms use reality as a blueprint for their virtual spaces, likely because they're also shaped by my memories.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yet, it's odd... My show is a late-night broadcast. It's not typical to have so many people sticking around...
Eleven!

A sharp, woman's voice slices through the air, aimed directly at you. A group of employees hurry over, encircling something that looks like a microphone. But as they part, you're shocked to see it's not some prop they're hoisting up—it's a person's severed head.
Just then, this "Mic" emits a jarring, pressing sound, demanding attention.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: Look at the clock! Why are you still loafing around?

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: The show's kicking off soon, you better get to the studio! How do you youngsters even manage to snooze through this?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The show...? Hold on, wasn't my show put on hold...

steps.speaker: Employee B
steps.content: Come on, Miss Eleven! It's nearly 3 in the morning!

steps.speaker: Employee A
steps.content: You know, Miss Eleven, you've become the star broadcaster of our station recently. Your live shows have a huge fan following!
You find yourselves encased by a sea of employees, being guided further into the heart of the building. Passing along the corridor, you once more notice the reflection of two figures in the glass.
Eleven's face is unsmiling, her features hidden in shadow, enigmatic and unclear.

You trail behind Eleven into the broadcasting room. There's just a microphone in front of you, a thin script, and onlookers from behind a nearby glass. The producer, with a microphone-head, appears to be speaking, but the silence glass muffles any sound.
In the absolute hush of the room, your own voice is the only sound you hear.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Feeling a bit nervous?

Eleven takes her place at the mic, expertly thumbing through the script and fine-tuning the volume. The instant she settles in, she seems to be in her element—her actions smooth and effortless, compelling enough to make your heart race just watching her.
There's an unmistakable tension, seeing how you've set things up. Everything is precise and well-planned, it gives off a vibe like "we're on the brink of something major."
I've been through much rougher patches. It's just your tight, professional setup that's making it seem like we're on the brink of something momentous.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: It's all a bit of a façade, kind of like how a news host fills time until the end credits roll.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Being a radio host, you don't have to be seen; this stuff is... just for their eyes.
Eleven looks up briefly at the soundproof glass. Outside, the crew is still huddled around the producer with a microphone-head.
Yet, you're truly a pro at this, aren't you? You seem to love what you do.
Eleven's hand hesitates, her face clouding over.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Indeed... But when it turns into something unsettling, a harbinger of danger...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: If liking is all there is, then it loses its purpose.
You're about to respond, to challenge her, but at that moment, the indicator light flashes on.
Eleven swiftly regains her composure, leans towards the microphone, and speaks gently.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Maybe you've wrapped up a busy day, or perhaps you're still mulling over the fatigue of today..."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "Welcome to Call at 3 AM. This is where you can talk about your worries, open up about what's on your mind, or share a slice of happiness."

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: "The night has settled in. Regardless of how your day went, I'm always here... ready to hear what you have to say."
Eleven gently unfolds the introduction for today's show. Her voice, processed and overlaid, turns into signals, broadcasting through the city on radio waves.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: So, let's bring in our first listener's call—
Following a few busy signals, the line finally connects to the studio.

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: Hi there... Am I on... Call at 3 AM?
A soothing voice whispers in your ear, reminiscent of the comforting warmth of a winter sun, casting a glow around you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes... that's right! I'm Eleven. Is there anything on your mind you'd like to share?

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: You know... there's this thing that's been on my mind for quite some time. I've been going back and forth on it, with no one around to bounce ideas off. I guess... maybe I could run it by you?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Absolutely, I'd be more than happy to lend an ear and share your burden.

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: So, here's the deal... I've been invited by one of my classmates to the school's anniversary dance, which is happening soon. Can you believe it? It's my first-ever invitation!

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: People have always said I'm not that attractive, my family included. That's why I usually play it safe with just T-shirts and jeans...

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: But, for the dance, dresses are a must, aren't they? So, I went ahead and chose a couple of dresses online that I thought might work...

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: I bet my family and friends will say they're not really "me"... But this is my first ever dance invite, and you've got to wear a dress for something like that, right? So... I'm really keen to hear what you think...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Alright, let's see here... We've got your photo and the picture of the dress you sent in.
On the screen next to Eleven, a photo appears. The girl in it is genuinely attractive, her smile a bit shy. The dress she picked is perfect for her, it's got this soft, classy vibe to it.
Eleven speaks softly and warmly, praising and encouraging the girl. She assures her that the pink princess dress with puff sleeves will definitely turn heads at the dance.
The girl is overjoyed, continuously thanking Eleven for her kind words.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: By the way, I've got a little secret that'll make you the star of the ball!

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: Eh? What's the scoop?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: The secret is confidence and a smile! Believe in your beauty, believe you are one of a kind, believe that your love can conquer all!

steps.speaker: Listener B
steps.content: Yes! I will... definitely smile like that!
As the call ends, Eleven's smile remains fixed on her face, even her final words echo with laughter.
At the moment of conclusion, Eleven turns to you and speaks.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You know, this is precisely why I'm determined to keep going.
Ah, I get it now.
That really means a lot.
Eleven's face is lit up with that warm, familiar smile, one you've missed since the events that separated you.

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Hey there? Hello? Are you getting this?
Just as you are savoring the memory of that charming caller, another call buzzes in.

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Can't believe I actually got through, that's amazing!
A bubbly voice chimes in, the soundboard's waveforms dancing along. You can almost imagine there's another charming girl on the line.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hey there, thrilled to connect with you... So, what's on your mind? Want to share a story, or need a listening ear?

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Oh? Nothing in particular, just couldn't catch any Z's and ended up calling the number on this leaflet.

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: I figured no one would be on the clock at this time! Sounds rough! What's your gig?

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Are you still showing off and engaging with your audience like this, in need of cash much? Then you turn up here, selling your voice like it's some kind of commodity?

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: I guess you're getting loads of calls, right?

The fantasy dissipates, and you can't fathom how she can speak so bluntly. You watch Eleven's nails, clawing tensely at the table. You yearn to cut off this call, to stop the incessant ringing, but you're paralyzed.
Only Eleven can make that move.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Sorry, Call at 3 AM is simply a segment of our midnight talk show. I'm here to take your calls, maybe recite a little poem, or belt out a tune...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: All I'm aiming for is to keep you company, help you unwind, or share in your moods...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Honest interaction...

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: Is that all?

steps.speaker: Listener A
steps.content: That's pretty bland. Who knows if you're even telling the truth. Anyway, I'm out, hanging up now.
The voice on the other line vanishes swiftly, leaving only Eleven's audible sigh echoing in the studio.
You really ought to have cut her off, and then turned her down...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: She's one of our audience members; it's only polite to let her finish. Plus... the producer didn't give the cue to end the call.
Eleven glances outside. The producer with a microphone-head flashes her a thumbs-up. Her colleague beside her raises a tablet, apparently ready to show her something.
Narrowing your eyes, you focus intently and then see it—the latest hot search chart.
The hashtag <color=#fb9259>#What'sYourGig?#</color> is glaringly visible at the top of the trending list.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Appreciating that call, we'll... keep the lines open.
The producer lets every call through, and in that short hour, while there are moments of sharing and venting, there is a greater tide of harassment, abuse, taunting, and scorn.
Your mind is in sync with Eleven, perceiving her on the brink of a breakdown. But the producer doesn't call for a break; the program is still on.
She forbids herself to fall apart, and her work demands the same.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: Fantastic work, Eleven! Truly fantastic!

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: This show's hit the trending charts again. Your handling of that first call was stellar, likely to kickstart another hot topic!
As Eleven exits the studio, the producer with a microphone-head gives her shoulder a pat, sounding utterly pleased.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: Let's aim for even better next time!
Eleven gives a firm nod, ready to move on, but just then, a girl walks out of a nearby studio.
It looks like the producer has an idea; he walks over, gives the girl a reassuring pat on the shoulder, and leads her to Eleven.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Do you need something? Director, Miss Eleven?

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: Ah, Miss Eleven's radio show is all the rage these days. But honestly, the repetition of similar calls is starting to wear thin.

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Are you saying... you want me to be part of Miss Eleven's radio show?! Is that for real?!

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: You've been doing great. How about writing some scripts where you play a bullied girl, then call in as a listener to Eleven's show?

steps.speaker: Girl
steps.content: Really? Alright! I'll give it my all!
Eleven's eyes widen in astonishment. She observes the producer and the girl hatching a plan, a plan to transform her rare, authentic voice into yet another facade.
Yet, she is speechless, not a word can she muster.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: You should head back soon too, get ready for the next episode.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: Ah yes, here's something for you. Your show's really taking off, so you might be called in for a guest spot or to lend a hand every now and then.

steps.speaker: Eleven's Boss
steps.content: We've set you up with a terminal to make sure we can get in touch with you whenever necessary.
The microphone-head producer signals to a crew member who retrieves a shadowy, intriguing device from a drawer and hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Look at this...
You can clearly see it—this is the vintage terminal!!!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why is this terminal here?? Judging by its design, it's gotta be five years old at least!
Five years ago?! That jogs your memory—you remember the time when the "Ghost Call" urban legend first started to surface in your earlier investigation.
Your head spins and your back turns ice cold—a mysterious force is pushing Eleven to reenact the Ghost Call urban legend's main character's tale!
Eleven, her hands shaking, picks up the vintage terminal.
As soon as you grab the terminal, everything whirls around you. The space distorts and crumbles, just like when you first arrived!

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Why is this happening... It's all been scripted... My likes, my steadfastness... utterly pointless... It was the same in the past, and it's the same now... In this situation... there's no chance for any change!
